generated_evidence.heading_context_en: 1. Screen Function Specification / Integrations and Acceptance Criteria / SF-016 Transaction, event and audit behavior
generated_evidence.quote_en: **Confirmed:** Durable changes propagate `tenant_id`, `revision`, `actor_id`, `occurred_at` and correlation context. They are server/interface metadata, not mandatory user-editable fields. Case mutations, approval decisions and outbox inserts commit in one ACID transaction; search/webhooks reconcile asynchronously.
